description.raw: Passive. Rhys can move while attacking but he is unable to do so for 8s if under control effects. ATK SPD and Haste won't affect his attack animation speed. Every 1 ATK SPD or Haste grants him 2 Crit DMG Boost. Rhys fires at enemies within a arced radius, shooting 6 projectiles across the battlefield, each dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 40% (SP-based) damage to enemies on its path. Rhys then loads his lance with Blast Ammo, allowing his normal attacks to deal 180% (ATK-based) damage to the target and causing 40% (ATK-based) splash damage to enemies in a 1-tile arc behind the target until he is affected by a control effect.
